tagline: Diversified utility and manufacturing holding company serving rural communities
hero_kpi_rationale: Electric segment revenue represents 43% of total consolidated revenue and constitutes the core of the company's growth strategy

kpis.name: Electric Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the electric segment
kpis.description: Electric segment revenue, the company's primary business activity
kpis.signal: Increase in revenue due to higher kWh sales and fuel cost recovery

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.explanation: Operating income of the consolidated company
kpis.description: Consolidated operating income of the company, a key indicator of operational profitability
kpis.signal: Decrease in operating income due to higher purchased power and fuel costs

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income of the consolidated company
kpis.description: Consolidated net income of the company, the primary indicator of overall financial performance
kpis.signal: Decrease in net income due to lower operating income, partially offset by an increase in production tax credits (PTC)
